title: Detection & Follow-up: SSO/RBAC audit gaps, alert tuning and SLO realignment
creator: Sofia Alvarez
description: Summary: During a production degradation on 2026-02-21 we observed two correlated symptoms: delayed audit-log ingestion (30-90s spikes) and missing SSO assertion events for a subset of admin sessions. This ticket consolidates the incident follow-ups focused on observability, alert tuning, and SLO realignment for the auth/audit stack. Goals: 1) ensure audit events for authentication/authorization reach the analytics pipeline within defined SLOs, 2) create pragmatic alerts that catch regressions without high false-positive rates, 3) add synthetic/chaos verification for SSO flows and RBAC propagation, 4) publish an admin playbook for handling audit gaps and privilege changes.
acceptance_criteria: Audit ingestion SLO defined: 99.9% of auth/audit events available in analytics index within 60s of generation
An alert (pager + slack) triggers when 5-minute rolling 95th-percentile ingestion latency > 60s or dropout rate > 0.1%
Synthetic SSO probe added to staging and one production-safe region; probes exercise full SAML flow and validate audit event emission
RBAC propagation monitor added: detect and alert when role grants take >30s to apply across control plane
Playbook published in Confluence with step-by-step for detection, mitigation (fallback to legacy-assertion API), and communication templates
Automated daily audit-reconciliation job implemented to detect missing events and create tickets for any gaps > 1 hour
Dashboard panels added to Console: ingest latency histogram, event dropout heatmap by region, top 10 services by auth-error rate
At least one runbook-driven tabletop exercised with PM/SE/SRE present and notes captured
comments: 2026-02-25 Sofia Alvarez: Created ticket after post-incident sync. Immediate priorities: define SLO, build detection rule for ingest latency spikes, and add synthetic SSO probe. Assigned to Ravi.

2026-02-27 Ravi Patel: Spike root cause hypothesis: transient redis backpressure in audit-collector causing batching delays which then delayed kafka produce. Working with infra to reproduce in staging. Filed infra issue: INFRA-897 (link provided in artifacts).

2026-03-01 System: Alert test executed in staging; initial tuning produced 40% false positives due to normal nightly batch compaction. Decided to use percentile-based rule (95th over 5m) rather than raw count threshold.

2026-03-03 Ravi Patel: Added RBAC propagation probe that queries role assignments via control-plane API and compares against applied state in worker nodes; prototype pushed as PR #8423 (link in artifacts).

2026-03-05 PM Review (Liam Chen): Requested that customer-impact tiers be surfaced in the dashboard and that any alert mentioning admin-level sessions include escalation instructions to oncall manager. Updating playbook action items.

2026-03-08 Design Review (Anika Bose): UX for new dashboard panels reviewed. Recommended color and grouping changes to make audit-dropout heatmap readable for SRE during incident. Will iterate on mockups.
2026-03-11 Ravi Patel: Implemented ingestion latency SLO and added Grafana panel. Running a 72-hour baseline to refine thresholds. Preparing runbook for tabletop next week.
2026-03-12 Sofia Alvarez: Marked security review required; scheduled security review session for 2026-03-15 to approve playbook and alert escalation paths.
